heading: About Echelon Day Care
intro_html: Welcome to Echelon Day Care — where nurturing care meets joyful learning! We are a dedicated team of early childhood educators passionate about creating a safe, stimulating, and inclusive environment for children to grow and thrive.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.paragraph:
To build a foundation of lifelong learning by fostering creativity, confidence, and kindness
      in every child we care for.

mission.heading: Our Mission
bullets: Provide a secure and loving environment for all children.
Encourage curiosity through hands-on learning and play.
Support each child’s social, emotional, physical, and cognitive development.

team.heading: Our Team
team.paragraph:
Led by experienced educators and caregivers, our staff is trained in child safety, CPR,
      early childhood development, and emotional intelligence. We take pride in forming strong
      partnerships with parents and guardians.

why_choose_us.heading: Why Choose Us?
bullets: Daily learning through stories, music, art, and play.
Balanced indoor, outdoor and nap time.
Regular updates and photo sharing with parents.

neighborhoods.heading: Neighbourhoods we serve
neighborhoods.paragraph_html: Our centre is at 575 W 8th Ave in Mount Pleasant, on the border of Fairview and Cambie Village. We welcome families from across central Vancouver, including South Granville, Olympic Village, False Creek, Kitsilano, South Cambie, and Riley Park. We're a short drive or bus ride from the Broadway corridor, the Canada Line (Broadway–City Hall and Olympic Village stations), and Vancouver General Hospital.
